_purpose: NBS Mapping Studio settings. Each run records the settings it used.
_overlap_policy: ALL = a record satisfying the conditions of several detail lines counts in each (literal execution, flagged OVERLAP); MOST_SPECIFIC = only the most specific line, ties left unallocated.
_bo: Declared presentation of the BO report (e.g. 1000 when BO shows thousands). Detected mismatches are reported, never applied automatically.
